Cookiemobile! at Knightdale Station Park

Your child runs at Knightdale Station Park first, then joins the 4:00 pm Cookiemobile at East Regional Library for crafts, games and fun outside the library.

  • Bring a snack for the park so your toddler has energy for the crafts.
  • Give a heads-up before you walk over to the library, and let them carry something along.
  • Start the goodbye while they are still having fun, so leaving stays easy.

Or swap in

  • 🌳 Whippoorwill Park, then Muddy Boots

    Durham · 9:30 am–11 am

    Map · $1.50 for Durham residents, $6.50 for others · Sign-up needed

    A family needs to sign up for Muddy Boots. Your child plays at Whippoorwill Park, then joins a nature book and a walk to find nature right outside.

    • Dress them in boots that can get dirty.
    • Bring a small bag so they can collect leaves and sticks to look at.

  • 📅 Nature Peekers: The Bear's Winter House, then Blue Jay Point County Park

    Blue Jay Point County Park · North Raleigh / Wake Forest · 10:20 am–11:40 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up needed

    A family needs to sign up for Nature Peekers. Your child hears about a bear building a winter house, then plays at Blue Jay Point County Park.

    • Ask them what the bear might build with moss and logs.
    • Pack a snack for after the story.

  • 📅 Jingle Bell Tales, then Southgate Park

    Southgate Community Library · Raleigh · 10:25 am–11:40 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    Your child rings, sings and jingles at Jingle Bell Tales, then burns off energy at Southgate Park.

    • Let them pick a bell and shake it along with the songs.
    • Bring water for the playground.

  • 🌿 Beech Bluff County Park StoryWalk® 2026 (Self-Led), then Beech Bluff County Park

    Beech Bluff County Park · South Wake · 9:30 am–11 am

    Map · Free · No sign-up needed

    Your child walks the self-guided StoryWalk, reading a page at each stop, then plays at Beech Bluff County Park.

    • Let them lead and run ahead to the next page.
    • Bring a snack to eat at the playground.

Nothing else fits that today.
